info.role: Chains shaken in rhythm: metal jangle that changes every step
info.playing: Shaker patterns in eighths or sixteenths
info.mix: Use it instead of a shaker for grime

info.role: A pane of glass breaking: a burst and inharmonic shards
info.register: Any; higher notes are smaller panes
info.playing: Accents and impacts
info.mix: Place it on a cut or a downbeat; it layers well over a snare

info.role: A rivet gun click: tiny, tuned, a little crushed
info.register: C4–C7 sets the pitch of the click
info.playing: Fast patterns; use as a hat or a tick
info.mix: Tiny: it adds articulation to a beat, not weight

info.role: A dull, heavy thump like a fist on a body: impact without a clear pitch
info.playing: Impacts and heavy off-beats
info.mix: Layer under a snare for weight, or use alone for impacts

info.role: A clap with a metal ring and a broken sample rate; the flams are built in
info.playing: Backbeats
info.mix: Layer with a snare for the classic industrial backbeat

info.role: A saw pluck with a folded snap on the attack
info.playing: Sixteenth patterns and riffs
info.mix: The snap is 120 ms long; it cuts through without adding level

info.role: A tuned metal string snapped: comb body with a ring on top
info.playing: Arpeggios and ostinatos
info.mix: Rings at octaves; stays in key under any chord

info.role: A glass pluck, lightly crushed, bouncing in a ping-pong echo
info.playing: Arpeggios and sparse figures
info.mix: Echo is 3/16: it plays a counter-rhythm; SPACE down to tighten

info.role: A harp whose strings have rusted: resonant, crushed at the edges
info.playing: Broken chords and slow arpeggios
info.mix: Let notes ring; it wants space around it

info.role: An FM drop that falls into its note, clipped and metallic
info.playing: Fast patterns; every note drops in
info.mix: The drop is 60 ms; it reads as attack, not as a pitch bend

info.role: A tiny tuned tick: a burst of noise ringing a comb at the note
info.playing: Fast sixteenths; it is almost percussion
info.mix: Tiny on its own; double a bassline with it for articulation

info.role: A hollow wooden mallet: a sine shaped into overtones, knocking a comb
info.playing: Ostinatos and melodies
info.mix: Marimba-like but darker; velocity sets the knock

info.role: Digital static plucked into a tuned string
info.playing: Arpeggios; each note is a little different
info.mix: The grain changes every sixteenth on MOTION

info.role: A thumb piano with bent tines: a faint shifted shimmer and a little wobble
info.playing: Simple repeating figures
info.mix: Slightly off on purpose; pull MOTION down to steady it

info.role: A sync pluck that sparks on every note, with a ring two octaves up
info.playing: Fast arpeggios
info.mix: Bright attack: pair with a darker pad

info.role: A soft mallet on a dusty record
info.playing: Melodies and loops
info.mix: The dust sits on its own layer, filtered with the note

info.role: A thin, rectified pluck with a buzzing octave edge
info.playing: Riffs and arpeggios
info.mix: High-passed at 350 Hz: it layers over anything

info.role: A sine pluck that flares into bell harmonics as you hit harder
info.playing: Melodic patterns with dynamics
info.mix: Velocity is the timbre knob here

info.role: A high, brittle glass pluck with a faint shimmer
info.playing: Sparse high figures
info.mix: Lives up high; it never gets in the way

info.role: A resonant pluck whose accents follow a syncopated pattern locked to the bar
info.playing: Straight sixteenth notes; the accents make the groove
info.mix: Pattern B is on the eighths; MOTION 0 plays every note the same

info.role: A plucked piano wire: bright, ringing, a little crushed
info.playing: Arpeggios and counterpoint
info.mix: Rings for half a second; keep patterns open

info.role: A soft, tense sixteenth pulse with a ringing edge and a slightly broken sample rate
info.genres: Film score, thriller, ambient, industrial ballads
info.playing: Hold minor chords for a bar or two
info.mix: Quiet tension under dialogue or a vocal; the filter opens over four bars

info.role: A saw sequence with a folded accent pattern of its own, locked to the bar
info.playing: Hold chords; accents and arp interlock
info.mix: Pattern B pushes harder for the drop; MOTION 0 plays every step alike

info.role: Fast, random glass needles inside your chord, crushed at the edges
info.playing: Hold chords under something slower
info.mix: Reads as texture, not melody; the notes only come from the chord you hold

info.role: A swung pulse arp in the order you play, ringing on the off-beats
info.playing: Play chords note by note in the order you want
info.mix: 30% swing: line your drums up with it

info.role: A rusty eighth-note spiral up and down three octaves, ringing as it goes
info.playing: Hold two- or three-note chords low
info.mix: Three octaves: keep the chord low or it climbs into the cymbals

info.role: Crushed chord stabs stuttering in a gated pattern on the bar
info.genres: Industrial, breakbeat, drum and bass, trailer
info.playing: Hold chords; the gate is the rhythm
info.mix: Pattern B builds; MOTION 0 plays every sixteenth

info.role: A plain sine pulse, gently shaped, with a shifted shadow drifting against it
info.playing: Hold chords for long stretches
info.mix: The shadow is where the unease lives; MOTION 0 makes it a clean pulse

info.role: A sequence that talks: the vowel glides through four shapes over two bars
info.playing: Hold chords for two bars
info.mix: Vowels sit where a voice does; duck it under vocals

info.role: Dotted-eighth glass rolling against the beat, edged with a rectified buzz
info.playing: Hold chords for two bars; the 3-against-4 does the work
info.mix: Pairs with a straight-sixteenth hat for the push and pull

info.role: Heavy eighth-note steps walking down two octaves, folded and crushed
info.playing: Hold minor chords for a bar
info.mix: Mid-heavy: carve 400 Hz from guitars under it

info.role: Random digital droplets from your chord, each one a different timbre
info.playing: Hold chords under a steady beat
info.mix: Only chord notes play; the timbre changes every step in time

info.role: A slow, sparse pulse like a monitor in an empty room, with long echoes
info.playing: Hold chords; one note per beat
info.mix: Sparse on purpose; the echo fills the gaps

info.role: A sparking sync arp with gaps knocked into its rhythm
info.playing: Hold chords; the gaps line up with the bar
info.mix: MOTION 0 fills the gaps in

info.role: A rolling bass arp with a clean sub under a folded top
info.playing: Hold two- or three-note shapes low
info.mix: Dry and mono in the lows; sidechain it to the kick

info.role: A tight sixteenth pulse whose filter climbs for four bars and resets: a build that won't stop
info.playing: Hold one chord through a four-bar build
info.mix: The climb is on the song grid; start the chord on the bar

info.role: An arpeggio caught on a failing radio: band-passed, crushed, drifting off station
info.playing: Hold chords for two bars
info.mix: Band-passed: it never touches the bass or the air
